jan_defaults.question: How many vacation days do full-time staff get, and until when can unused days be carried over?
jan_defaults.answer: Full-time employees receive 27 days of paid vacation per calendar year. Unused vacation days can be carried over until March 31 of the following year, after which they expire. This information is from the employee handbook.
